label_definition.event_negative: inside the UNOSAT AnalysisExtent, outside the flood polygons
label_definition.event_positive: inside a UNOSAT polygon classed 'Flood Water', 15 Dec 2019 Sentinel-1
label_definition.excluded: permanent water bodies, and trace occurrence below 5.0%
label_definition.positive: 5.0 <= GSW occurrence < 75.0 (observed under water, not permanent)

limitations: GSW non-permanent water in Malaysia includes paddy, aquaculture and ex-mining ponds, which are managed water rather than flood; the UNOSAT set is the control for that confound.
The UNOSAT set is one event, one date, two AOIs in Johor.
GSW is Landsat-derived and misses flooding under cloud, which biases its negatives toward false negatives in the wet season.
not_a_failure_label: Neither label records an outage, a fault or a maintenance action. Both record observed surface water. No failure label exists in this project and none is created here.
title: Observed-inundation ground truth for the flood factor
